title: -게 하다 causativa
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL grammar description analyzes **-게 하다** as a causative/permissive construction in which a subject causes or allows a target to perform an action. It documents alternative case marking for the target (e.g., **아이가/아이를/아이에게** with **앉게 하다**); this entry is limited to those patterns and does not treat one marker as obligatory in every context.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). *한국어교육 문법·표현 내용 개발 연구(3단계) [Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3)]*. https://www.korean.go.kr/common/download.do;front=B5CD4F10151810563982D51A3FD4329B?c_file_name=5a2db2bc-a7ad-49f4-84a4-34b20ad33ffc_0.pdf&file_path=reportData&o_file_name=%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4%EA%B5%90%EC%9C%A1+%EB%AC%B8%EB%B2%95%ED%91%9C%ED%98%84+%EB%82%B4%EC%9A%A9%EA%B0%9C%EB%B0%9C+%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC_3%EB%8B%A8%EA%B3%84.pdf

Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3), PDF pp. 377–378 (printed pp. 365–366): -게 하다 section, target participant and examples with 이/를/에게.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con la marcación del participante causado mediante **에게/한테** o **을/를**, con construcciones causativas más compactas y con estructuras de causa como **때문에**, aunque estas últimas expresan motivo y no una causación sintáctica.
